```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
```

Read in the data:

```{r}
atp_w34 <- haven::read_sav("~/Downloads/W34_Apr18/ATP W34.sav")
```

Get party affiliations and leanings:

```{r}
atp_w34 %>% 
  mutate(
    party = as_factor(F_PARTY_FINAL),
    party_lean = as_factor(F_PARTYLN_FINAL)) %>% 
  select(party, party_lean)
```
```{r}
atp_w34$F_PARTYSUM_FINAL %>% attributes()
```
